title: SnakeLands.io
desc: The wild is alive with motion and danger. Rival snakes close in, waiting for a single mistake. Grow faster, bite harder and outsmart them all. Evolve beyond limits and show that only those with courage and cunning can claim true power.
howto: Begin your journey as a small but ravenous snake
Move with strategy, consume your enemies and grow bigger with each bite
Collect gold to boost speed, ferocity and stamina, earn trophies and unlock stages with even deadlier snakes
tips: Play safe early; grow before you pick fights.
Cut opponents off rather than chasing them.
